test_save_image_rgb24_parity: test spdl.io.save_image encodes rgb24 numpy arrays to PNG and reads back identically
test_save_image_gray_parity: test spdl.io.save_image encodes gray numpy arrays to PNG and reads back identically
test_save_image_torch_tensor: test spdl.io.save_image encodes torch tensors to PNG with rgb24 or gray pixel format
test_save_image_gray16be: test spdl.io.save_image encodes uint16 big-endian grayscale arrays to PNG with gray16be format
test_save_image_rejects_invalid_dtypes: test spdl.io.save_image raises ValueError when given unsupported dtypes like uint16 or float for rgb24
